boundsMethod: Exact transformed POSITION vertices, not transformed local accessor bounding boxes. All coordinates include the glTF ancestor matrices.

hierarchy.interpretation: Imported scene is Y-up, uses approximately 0.01 scale from exporter units, and front-facing surfaces point toward +X. Keep imported ancestor matrices or bake full matrixWorld before regrouping. Do not apply another 0.01 scale.

desktopSlab.meaning: Desktop surface only; no separate legs. Omit when using the separately sourced desk.

monitor.meaning: Monitor frame, stand and display; includes the rear connector.

speakerSourceNegativeZ.meaning: Speaker cabinet and two driver details. After yaw=-90deg this becomes the right-side speaker before recentering.

speakerSourcePositiveZ.meaning: Second matching speaker, cabinet and two driver details.

mouse.meaning: Mouse body, wheel, buttons and surface mark; no trailing cable.

mousepad.meaning: Thin mouse mat, separate from mouse.

keyboard.meaning: Entire detailed keyboard including every cap and text legend.

externalCables.meaning: Long connection cables; preserve in original composition, omit or reroute when moving individual devices.

pcTower.meaning: PC chassis, motherboard, fans, GPU, power supply, interior wiring and rear antenna details.

screen.materialRecommendation: Replace mesh288 material with MeshBasicMaterial({map: existingCanvasTexture,toneMapped:false,side:THREE.DoubleSide}); retain geometry/UV. Set CanvasTexture.flipY=true for the listed conventional UVs, then verify text upright visually. Do not multiply the glTF-derived base-color/emissive maps with the canvas. Shutdown can drive this replacement material.color to zero.

integrationNotes: Prefer independent prop groups to scaling the whole arrangement; the supplied desk is much wider than the existing stage and its original keyboard is left of the desired actor anchor.

Call scene.updateMatrixWorld(true) before extracting. To preserve transforms, use group.attach(topObject) or clone every mesh and apply its full original matrixWorld to cloned geometry; simply remove/add loses the ancestor 0.01 matrix.
Before spatial regrouping, remove the external cable groups from the visible transformed copy. They connect original positions and will cross the scene after device moves. Keep the raw GLB unchanged.
GLTFLoader may sanitize names or add suffixes. Use parser.associations node indices, or exact parent-name mapping after loading, rather than relying on scene.traverse order.

Suggested speaker and mouse placement uses the existing tabletop at world y=1.67. Monitor stand lands at y≈1.681 with the given screen-centered transform. The PC tower placement is on the floor outside the right desk edge; confirm camera framing and collision with the downloaded environment.
The mouse is a replacement for the illustrative reaction key, so remap the character hand to the actual mouse top rather than the old key height.

optimization.recommendation: Bake each static mesh geometry with full original matrixWorld, then merge within each semantic prop group and each actual material index. Reuse original textures and materials. Retain screen as its own mesh/material and mouse button/power-action pieces if animated.
cautions: Do not merge transparent material with opaque parts.
Preserve normals with the normal matrix, UV channels, color attributes and triangle winding. Three BufferGeometry.applyMatrix4 handles position/normal transforms.

Primitive attributes differ (keyboard contains UV0/UV1/UV2); normalize required attribute layouts before mergeGeometries. Missing irrelevant UV attributes can be omitted only when materials do not use them.
Avoid one global 86-material merge if each prop must be placed independently.
World bounds and groups are verified numerically; GPU appearance, text orientation and screen readability still require actual browser playback.
